description: Returns an object with the sync status of the node if the node is out-of-sync and is syncing. Returns false when the node is already in sync.

result.description: The result is false if JSON Object is not syncing otherwise it's true:

result.startingBlock.description: The block at which the import started encoded as hexadecimal

result.currentBlock.description: The current block, same as eth_blockNumber encoded as hexadecimal

result.highestBlock.description: The estimated highest block encoded as hexadecimal
